mapper.select: SELECT CAST(u.id AS CHAR) id, m.code, m.name, m.model, u.quantity, u.status, DATE_FORMAT(u.created_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') installedAt FROM inv_usage u JOIN inv_material m ON m.tenant_id=u.tenant_id AND m.id=u.material_id WHERE u.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND u.equipment_id=#{equipmentId} AND u.status='在用' ORDER BY u.created_at DESC,u.id DESC
